comparison.baseline_definition: Previous completed calendar month units / calendar days, separately by product and store. Analytical interpretation of supplied last-month description; exact incumbent not evaluable.
comparison.target_definition: Positive product units on order dates with normalized statuses completed, shipped or returned; include returned positive units as gross outgoing, do not subtract restockable returns without evidence. Remove exact duplicates, reject conflicting transaction IDs, quarantine negative quantities. Include zero quantity records without effect.
comparison.status_and_return_rules: Positive product units on order dates with normalized statuses completed, shipped or returned; include returned positive units as gross outgoing, do not subtract restockable returns without evidence. Remove exact duplicates, reject conflicting transaction IDs, quarantine negative quantities. Include zero quantity records without effect.
comparison.missingness_and_exposure: Do not impute missing input quantities. Aggregate recorded units to calendar windows, conditional on supplied transaction extract representing recorded orders; no claim that absence proves zero underlying demand. Global dates are continuous. Store-day absences may be closure, no sales or missing reporting. Check exposure sensitivity using store transaction-active dates and independently report performance on horizons with all store dates observed. Do not represent transaction inventory levels as historical stock.
comparison.population: Current supplied stock/policy keys, checked for 1:1 agreement and historical support at every origin; 336 pairs. Historical assortment not supplied: fixed current population is conditional and not proof of historical availability.

secondary_horizons.deployment_coverage: Supplier lead time 1-7 plus review 7 = 8-14 days. Secondary variable horizon uses November 30 policy as a forecast-horizon diagnostic, not historical purchasing policy. Primary next-week selection may differ from full-coverage performance; disclose if so.
